Performance tuning, tile layout, and benchmarking guidance for Firedancer.

# Purpose
This file documents Firedancer performance tuning and benchmark configuration for the validator layout. It explains the tile-based execution model, the CPU core affinity settings, and which tile counts can be changed to tune throughput. It also describes the `fddev` benchmark workflow, the limits that affect measured TPS, and the configuration changes used to test higher load, such as larger tile counts, more funded accounts, and disabled RPC storage. The examples show how to use `default.toml` and a custom benchmark TOML file to measure and improve validator performance on a specific machine.
